findings.current: Well, quitting the Guild, retiring, and farming with Butler Kim wouldn’t be so bad.
findings.defect: The draft turns shutting down the Guild into personally quitting it, changing the proposed action.
findings.rationale: 길드 접고 means closing or disbanding the Guild, not merely leaving it.
findings.replacement: Well, shutting down the Guild, retiring, and farming with Butler Kim wouldn’t be so bad.
findings.source: 뭐, 길드 접고 은퇴해서 김 집사님이랑 농사짓는 것도 나쁘진 않네요.

findings.current: If you send me away, send Uncle Kkeokjeong and Song-i away too, and even the new recruits leave, are you two still planning to fight Ares Guild?
findings.defect: The English makes “send Uncle Kkeokjeong and Song-i away” read as an imperative rather than another condition in Taekyung’s hypothetical.
findings.rationale: All three departures are hypothetical conditions leading to Taekyung’s question about whether Choi and Butler Kim would fight alone.
findings.replacement: If you send me away, send Uncle Kkeokjeong and Song-i away as well, and even the new recruits leave, do you two plan to fight Ares Guild by yourselves?
findings.source: 나 내보내고, 꺽정 아저씨랑 송이도 보내고. 새로 받아들인 신입들까지 떠나면 두 분께서 아레스 길드와 싸울 생각입니까?

findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung’s accomplishments the subject, while Taekyung is asking whether he himself is insufficient.
findings.rationale: The omitted Korean subject is established by the surrounding assessment of Jin Taekyung and Choi’s subsequent calculation of his value.

findings.current: I had hunted Named Monsters alone, crushed nearly thirty Black Hunters, and stood face-to-face against a major Guild like Myeongdong Guild.
findings.defect: The draft changes the single Named Monster Taekyung hunted into multiple Named Monsters.
findings.rationale: The source refers to 네임드 몬스터 in the singular context of Taekyung’s established feat, and 정면으로 맞섰다 means confronting the Guild head-on.
findings.replacement: I had hunted a Named Monster alone, crushed nearly thirty Black Hunters, and confronted a major Guild like Myeongdong Guild head-on.
findings.source: 단신으로 네임드 몬스터를 사냥하고, 서른에 달하는 블랙 헌터를 갈아 버렸으며 명동 길드라는 대형 길드와 정면으로 맞섰다.

findings.current: “Because they promised me twice my salary.”
findings.defect: The draft replaces the identifiable singular subject, Team Leader Choi, with an unspecified plural subject.
findings.rationale: The honorific singular construction 주신댔거든 and the immediately preceding reference to following Team Leader Choi identify him as the person who made the promise.
findings.replacement: “Because Team Leader Choi promised me double my salary.”

findings.current: Then, among the densely packed holographic windows, I found what I wanted.
findings.defect: The draft changes one holographic window packed with entries into multiple holographic windows.
findings.rationale: 창 is singular here, while 빼곡하게 적힌 describes the contents displayed within that window.
findings.replacement: Then, in the holographic window packed with entries, I found what I wanted.
findings.source: 그리고 빼곡하게 적힌 홀로그램 창에서 내가 원하는 것을 발견할 수 있었다.

findings.current: Something in my words reached Team Leader Choi.
findings.defect: The draft omits that Choi specifically recognizes the sincerity carried in Taekyung’s words.
findings.rationale: 진심 is an explicit characterization cue explaining why hope begins to enter Choi’s eyes.
findings.replacement: Team Leader Choi sensed the sincerity behind my words.
findings.source: 내 말에 실린 진심을 느낀 최 팀장의 눈동자에 빛이 스며든다.

findings.current: People treated him as nothing more than a low-rank Hunter in name, but Im Kkeokjeong was one of the few real Hunters left in this age.
findings.defect: “A low-rank Hunter in name” suggests his low rank is merely nominal, rather than conveying that people dismiss him as a hollow, unimpressive low-rank Hunter.
findings.rationale: 허울뿐인 characterizes how others regard him as all title and no substance, setting up the contrast with his genuine sense of duty.
findings.replacement: People dismissed him as a low-rank Hunter with nothing but the title, but Im Kkeokjeong was one of the few true Hunters left in this age.
findings.source: 사람들은 그를 허울뿐인 하급 헌터라 취급하지만, 임꺽정야말로 이 시대에 몇 남지 않은 진짜 헌터다.

findings.current: Team Leader Choi’s face was undergoing a huge, violent upheaval unlike anything I had ever seen before.
findings.defect: “Face was undergoing an upheaval” is an unnatural literal collocation in English.
findings.rationale: The replacement naturally conveys the unprecedented, intense agitation visible on his face without changing the action.
findings.replacement: Team Leader Choi looked more violently shaken than I had ever seen him before.
findings.source: 최 팀장의 얼굴에는 지금까지 본 적 없는, 크고 격렬한 동요가 일어나고 있었다.

findings.current: Unlike their boiling hearts, their cool heads had already calculated the answer.
findings.defect: “Unlike their boiling hearts” is an awkward Korean-syntax calque.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the contrast between their heated emotions and dispassionate reasoning in natural English.
findings.replacement: Their blood might have been boiling, but their cool heads had already calculated the answer.
findings.source: 끓어오르는 가슴과는 달리 냉철한 두뇌는 이미 답을 계산해 냈다.

findings.current: I know a considerable part of Ares Guild, if not everything about it.
findings.defect: “Know a considerable part of Ares Guild” is an unnatural collocation and can suggest knowing a physical subdivision rather than extensive information.
findings.rationale: 상당 부분을 알고 있다 means possessing substantial knowledge about the Guild.
findings.replacement: I may not know everything about Ares Guild, but I know a great deal.
findings.source: 아레스 길드의 전부까지는 아니더라도, 상당 부분을 알고 있습니다.

summary: The draft contains several actionable fidelity errors, including altered actions, subjects, quantities, and UI structure, plus omissions affecting characterization and register.
